I posted this on another post, but it's relevant to the sub:

It is possible, but you have to do it for individual usernames. There is no "moderator" class yet, so you have to do special things. I did this with me here. The class for the OP is a.author so you can do things like 

a.author {
 color: red;
}

or 

a.author:after {
 content: " (OP)"
}

if you want. You can add or change anything.

To change a mod you gotta edit .tagline .moderator. This makes all moderators usernames black:

.tagline .moderator {
 color: black;
}

You can do :before, :after, :hover etc. with it as well:

.tagline .moderator:hover {
 font-size: 11px;
 color: orange;
}

So enjy and have fun!

EDIT: ALL following info is outdated, but still works I guess...

To make mods look special, you have to edit them individually. Whoaverse has a 4k character limit on the CSS so you have to use this wisely. Lets say I was a mod in your subverse. This will give me a special color:

a[href$="/user/Mewtwo"] {
 color: blue !important;
}

and this will put [M] after my name:

a[href$="/user/Mewtwo"]:after {
 content: " [M]";
}

Good luck!

I should add you can do the last part for anybody, not just mods, but I recommend you use it for special users/mods.
